messages:
mike.r: Post-mortem follow-up: during yesterday's Private rollout we hit an issue where tenant control-plane traffic routed through the shared edge caused cross-tenant latency spikes and sticky sessions.
anika.s: tl;dr: root cause?
mike.r: shared edge cached routes to the old controlplane pool. some connections stuck to old backends due to TCP session affinity + cached DNS entries; reconcilers fixed routes later but the sticky window lasted minutes.
tom.h: why are controlplane calls still going through the shared edge for tenants that moved to isolated CPs? we assumed direct routing.
mike.r: historical simplification: keep a single ingress plane for observability. with Private we're hitting the limits of that model.
liz.v: let's sketch options: 1) per-tenant edge instances (heavy ops/cost), 2) routing tags + stronger invalidation (epoching), 3) sidecar/agent short-circuit so edge forwards to tenant agent in VPC, 4) direct resolution & short-lived direct connections from edge to tenant endpoint.
anika.s: per-tenant edge is expensive. epoching helps with stale maps but won't solve live TCP sessions. sidecar short-circuit looks promising since customers already run outbound agents.
tom.h: agent-based short-circuit: reuse outbound control tunnel and peer inbound CP traffic over it. agent terminates TLS with tenant certs. security-wise mTLS + controlplane-signed JWT for auth.
mike.r: tradeoffs: tunnels increase idle connections and CPU on agents; but keep keys inside customer VPC and preserve observability.
liz.v: hybrid approach: short-term implement epoched routing + active drain on route bump (drain window ~20s). mid-term implement agent short-circuit with connection pooling. long-term offer isolation tiers (shared, routed-relay, dedicated-edge).
anika.s: metrics to add: route_stale_rate, tcp_sticky_sessions, edge_cpu_by_tenant, agent_tunnel_count, epoch_apply_lag. create alerts for sticky_sessions > threshold.
tom.h: rollout plan: unit tests for epoching + drain logic, staging canary with 10% tenants, measure stale_rate for 24h. If good, expand. Parallel work: proto agent short-circuit in staging.
sre-bot: scheduled: cp-edge-shortcircuit-canary -> staging @ 2025-11-05T17:00:00Z
mike.r: I'll draft RFC 'cp-edge-shortcircuit-and-tiered-isolation' with diagrams, decision record, and cost estimates. tagging security for agent auth design. Thanks all.
